title: MachineCostBasisV1
description: Governed per-machine hour-cost basis. Connects a machine profile (via machine_id) to a machine-hour COST rate used by costing. This is a true-cost rate (burden + electricity + tooling), NOT a customer-facing billing rate and NOT a margin-inclusive price. Electricity is derived from the referenced profile's connected load. Each cost input carries its own {source, confidence} provenance so the record does not overstate how well-supported its inputs are: use owner_confirmed only when a supporting owner-confirmation artifact exists, otherwise inherited_shop_default at draft confidence. Strict structure: unknown keys are rejected. 'status' tracks the review state of the record; the artifact is governed/test-protected regardless of status value.

source.description: owner_confirmed requires a supporting owner-confirmation artifact; inherited_shop_default is a generic shop number carried forward without machine-specific evidence.

machine_id.description: Foreign key into a governed machine profile, e.g. MACHINE-BCM2030CA-ATC-V1

machine_burden_rate_per_hour.description: Depreciation + maintenance + insurance + overhead per machine-hour. Not derived here; provenance recorded in machine_burden_provenance.

connected_load_kw.description: Must match the referenced machine profile's connected_load_estimate.total_kw

load_factor.description: Physical average load ratio 0.0-1.0 (NOT percentage points)

electricity_cost_per_hour.description: Derived: connected_load_kw * load_factor * price_per_kwh, rounded to 2 dp

tooling_cost_per_hour.description: Consumable tooling wear allowance per machine-hour. Provenance recorded in tooling_provenance.

machine_hour_rate.description: Derived: machine_burden_rate_per_hour + electricity.electricity_cost_per_hour + tooling_cost_per_hour, rounded to 2 dp
